review_candidates.description: Position: Help Desk Technician I, II, or III Division Information Technology Department: Information Technology Reports To: Executive Director of Information Technology  Location: Open Exempt/Non-Exempt: Non-Exempt Pay Grade: Tier I: Grade 9 ($21.97 - $33.50) Tier II: Grade 10 ($24.61 - $37.52) Tier III: Grade 11 ($27.07 - $40.11) Classification: Full-Time Summary: The Ponca Tribe of Nebraska is a federally recognized Tribe with its ancestral homeland located in Niobrara, NE. The Tribe does not have a reservation in the classic definition; rather, the Ponca Restoration Act defined its jurisdiction as a ‘Service Delivery Area’ comprised of 15 counties throughout parts of Nebraska, Iowa, and South Dakota. Within its Service Delivery Area, the Tribe offers a broad range of health, social, educational, and cultural services.  The help desk technician provides technical support and assistance, via phone, in person or remotely for computer systems, software and hardware. Help desk technicians are expected to be customer/end user focused to resolve technical issues in a timely manner. The help desk technician progress through three tiers: Tier I, Level 1 support, basic IT support, Tier II, Level II support, trouble shooting, and Tier III, Level 3 support, expert level support. All Tiers are a first point of contact and interact directly with the end users.  Essential Responsibilities and Duties:   Tier I: Provide Level 1, basic IT support to users. Serve as the first point of contact for customers who require technical assistance via phone, email, or help desk system. Troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve technical hardware and/or software issues. Provide quick resolution of customer support needs with excellent customer service. Escalate unresolved issues to the next level of support. Document issues and their resolution in the help desk system. Follow-up with customers and train them when necessary. Install and configure computer hardware, software, systems, networks, and peripherals. Provide needed information on IT products and services. Other duties as assigned. Tier II: All Tier I essential responsibilities and duties listed above. Provide Level 2, troubleshooting IT support to users. Assists in training, guidance, and mentoring to all Tier I help desk technicians. Perform system administration duties to network, servers and software systems. Assist in user account management. Tier III: All Tier I and Tier II essential responsibilities and duties listed above. Provide Level 3, expert IT support to users. Assists in training, guidance, and mentoring to all Tier I and Tier II help desk technicians. Oversees group policies. Assist in Active Directory/EntraID and user permissions. Assist with network security, backups and improving organizational IT security posture. Relationships and Authority:   This position has no supervisory duties. Works in conjunction with directors, managers, other Ponca Tribe of Nebraska staff, and external entities.  Working Environment and Physical Demands:   Physical requirements include carrying/lifting up to 5 pounds, frequently; up to 10 pounds, regularly; and up to 45 pounds, occasionally. Visual acuity, speech, and hearing; hand and eye coordination and manual dexterity necessary to drive an automobile and operate a computer keyboard and basic office equipment; subject to carrying, lifting, twisting, and reaching to perform essential job functions. Working conditions are primarily in an office environment with occasional travel to other locations. Qualifications:   Minimum: Tier I: 1. High School Diploma or equivalent. 2. Knowledge of Microsoft Office 365, Microsoft operating systems, mobile devices, networking, and multimedia. 3. Ability to coordinate and prioritize multiple tasks simultaneously while maintaining attention to detail and quality under minimal supervision. 4. Valid driver’s license and be insurable. 5. Successfully pass drug and alcohol testing, motor vehicle, education, character, and criminal background checks. 6. Able and willing to travel. Tier II: 1. All Tier I minimum qualifications. 2. Two years of experience in a help desk technician I role or equivalent experience. 3. Two years of experience diagnosing and resolving basic technical issues. 4. Prepared to provide level 2 support, troubleshooting support to end users. 5. Proven track record of customer service and resolving user IT issues. Tier III: 1. All Tier I and Tier II minimum qualifications. 2. Two years of experience in a help desk technician II role or equivalent experience. 3. Two years of experience troubleshooting advanced technical issues. 4. Prepared to provide Level 3 support, expert IT support to users. 5. Associate’s degree or certification from Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Cisco, HP, or other equivalent technology provider.   Preferred:   Associate’s degree or Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent field. Experience working on an IT help desk. Experience using remote support tools Experience with any of the following: Office 365, Active Directory, EntraID, remote desktop, cloud, VoIP, encryption, VPN, LAN, WAN, and wireless. IT relevant certifications. One year of experience working with Native Americans or Native American organizations. Knowledge and understanding of Public Law 93-638: Indian Self-Determination Act, Tribal organizations and funding opportunities. Preference will be given to Ponca Tribe of Nebraska members or members of a federally recognized tribe. However, all qualified individuals are eligible. The Ponca Tribe of Nebraska is an at-will employer.   Tribal Council Approval: 08/17/2026

review_candidates.title: Senior Technical Support Engineer – Software & IT Connectivity
review_candidates.description: ABOUT US At Vitrafy Life Sciences , we’re not just part of the biotech industry—we’re redefining it by improving the quality of healthcare treatments through effective cryopreservation solutions. Our breakthrough technologies have the potential to create new global standards for how biological materials are preserved, transported, and delivered, ultimately helping preserve life. Our integrated cryopreservation technology spans devices, packaging, and our LifeChain™ software platform, designed to retain the quality of biological material across the entire cryopreservation supply chain. Vitrafy is Australian-based, with headquarters in South Melbourne, manufacturing and scientific laboratory operations in Ballarat, and established operations in the United States. ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for a Senior Technical Support Engineer to serve as a highly technical escalation point for our LifeChain™ platform, Azure environment, customer IT connectivity, and connected cryopreservation systems. This role sits at the intersection of software, cloud infrastructure, networking, IoT, and customer support . You will own complex customer escalations from initial diagnosis through resolution, working directly with customer IT teams and internal Engineering, Product, R&D, Field Service, and Commercial Operations teams. Most of your work will focus on LifeChain™ application behavior, Azure services, data pipelines, integrations, firewalls, certificates, identity, and secure device-to-cloud transmission in hospital, blood center, and laboratory environments. This is a hands-on technical role. You will work directly with logs, telemetry, dashboards, diagnostic tools, and network details while communicating clearly with customers and internal stakeholders. The ideal candidate is technically credible, calm under pressure, and comfortable making practical recommendations when complex issues need to be resolved quickly and correctly. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES LifeChain™ Platform & Software Escalation | ~40% Build strong working knowledge of LifeChain™ and related technologies, including web applications, microservices, databases, Azure services, IoT connectivity, and data pipelines. Lead hands-on technical triage using logs, telemetry, monitoring dashboards, application performance data, query traces, and diagnostic tools to isolate root cause. Setup and deployment of customer environments on Azure to include infrastructure work to stand up new clients as well as Azure optimization and consolidation Diagnose application issues including workflow errors, data integrity problems, reporting discrepancies, performance degradation, and processing or automation failures. Investigate data pipeline and storage issues from instrument to cloud, including ingestion failures, incomplete or duplicate records, latency, and reconciliation issues. Evaluate technical trade-offs and recommend solutions that balance customer impact with product integrity. Track releases and deployments to ensure support readiness, documentation, and customer communications are aligned. Cloud & Customer IT Connectivity | ~40% Own end-to-end connectivity troubleshooting from instruments on customer laboratory networks through firewalls and network infrastructure to secure data transmission into LifeChain™. Work directly with customer IT and security teams on firewall and proxy configuration, outbound allowlisting, ports and protocols, VLANs, network segmentation, and site readiness. Diagnose TLS, certificate, authentication, telemetry, and data transmission issues. Support identity and access configuration, including SSO, directory integration, and role-based access. Investigate Azure IoT Hub, IoT Edge, device credentials, certificates, protocol fallback, store-and-forward behavior, and data integrity. Use Linux command-line tools to investigate services, containers, logs, disk and resource constraints, networking, and name resolution. Apply security and data-handling best practices when accessing customer environments and connected devices. Partner with Engineering on remote diagnostic tooling, monitoring, alerting, and dashboards for platform uptime, device connectivity, and data transmission health. Hardware-Adjacent Triage | ~20% Determine whether reported faults originate in the instrument, software, or network. Interpret device diagnostics, sensor readings, alarms, and error states to isolate instrument faults remotely and rule out software or connectivity causes. Provide Field Service and firmware teams with precise, evidence-based technical handoffs. Identify recurring hardware-related patterns and provide feedback to Product, R&D, and Field Service. Customer Experience & Support Serve as the final internal escalation point for complex or high-priority customer issues spanning software, cloud, connectivity, and connected equipment. Own escalations from diagnosis through resolution, customer communication, and confirmation that the solution is effective. Support customers through phone, email, chat, and remote sessions according to defined severity levels and response targets. Participate in after-hours escalation support for critical issues when required. Recognize and document customer complaints in accordance with quality-system requirements. Identify and promptly escalate potential safety issues and reportable events in accordance with medical-device vigilance and post-market procedures. Contribute to support KPIs including first response time, platform uptime, resolution rate, and NPS. Knowledge, Collaboration & Continuous Improvement Maintain diagnostic runbooks, troubleshooting guides, network references, and known-issue documentation. Improve support platforms, workflows, knowledge bases, and remote diagnostic capabilities. Translate Engineering, Product, and R&D knowledge into practical support guidance. Partner with Product and R&D to provide customer insights and support product improvements and new product introductions. Collaborate with IT, Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, and Field Service on technical and customer initiatives. Analyze support data and customer feedback to identify recurring root causes and opportunities for preventative improvements. Recommend improvements to diagnostic processes, tooling, and workflows while staying current with relevant technologies and cloud services. ABOUT YOU Required 5+ years of experience in technical support engineering, escalation engineering, cloud support, or a comparable customer-facing technical role, including senior or escalation-level experience. Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience. Hands-on Azure experience across compute, storage, monitoring, and Log Analytics, including diagnostic work with logs and telemetry. Strong networking knowledge including firewalls, proxies, ports and protocols, DNS, TLS/certificates, VPNs, and troubleshooting in customer-controlled environments. Experience working directly with customer IT and security teams to resolve connectivity, access, or integration issues. Working knowledge of modern web application technologies such as TypeScript, React or similar frameworks, Node.js, and microservice architectures, with the ability to read code and interpret logs. Experience with Azure IoT Hub, Azure IoT Edge, or an equivalent device-to-cloud platform, including device identity, credentials, edge modules, and API troubleshooting. Practical Linux experience including command-line troubleshooting, services, system logging, containers, file systems, resource constraints, and networking. Ability to write queries to investigate issues, including KQL and SQL. Strong written technical communication skills and the ability to explain complex technical issues to customers, IT teams, and non-technical stakeholders. Highly Regarded Experience supporting SaaS or cloud-connected products within hospitals, clinical laboratories, or restricted enterprise networks. Exposure to PLC or industrial control systems and protocols such as IEC 61131-3, CODESYS, OPC UA, MQTT, or similar technologies. Experience with SSO, SAML/OIDC, directory integration, and role-based access control. Understanding of refrigeration or thermal control systems and sensor behavior. Experience in medical device, bioscience, life sciences, or another regulated technology environment. Experience with complaint handling, post-market surveillance, or quality systems such as ISO 13485. Experience coaching other support engineers. Familiarity with connected instrumentation or laboratory equipment. KEY COMPETENCIES Customer-first mindset with sound judgment around urgency and product integrity. Hands-on technical credibility across logs, dashboards, network traces, and diagnostic tools. Ability to translate complex cloud, software, network, and hardware interactions into clear recommendations. Strong practical problem-solving skills in complex environments. Accuracy and attention to technical and customer data. Ability to collaborate effectively across teams and organizational levels. Continuous improvement and growth mindset. Target Pay Range: $130,000–$155,000 Salary will be determined based on education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, internal equity, and alignment with market data. THE PERKS Our benefits include medical, dental, and vision plan options. We also support long-term financial well-being through a 401(k) plan, along with unlimited vacation and sick time programs to help employees maintain a healthy work-life balance. Ready to Preserve the Future with Us? If you’re ready to join a fast-growing biotech leader where your work drives global change, Vitrafy Life Sciences is your next move.

Administration systèmes Administrer et maintenir les environnements Linux (Red Hat, Debian, Ubuntu, Rocky Linux, CentOS...) Assurer le maintien en condition opérationnelle (MCO) et de sécurité (MCS) des serveurs Gérer l'installation, la configuration, les mises à jour et les correctifs des systèmes Administrer les services systèmes (SSH, DNS, DHCP, NFS, Apache, Nginx...) Superviser les performances, la disponibilité et la capacité des infrastructures Diagnostiquer et résoudre les incidents techniques de niveaux 2 et 3 Automatisation & industrialisation Développer et maintenir des scripts d'automatisation en Bash, Shell ou Python Automatiser les tâches récurrentes d'administration et d'exploitation Participer au déploiement et à la gestion des configurations via des outils tels qu'Ansible, Puppet ou Terraform Contribuer à l'industrialisation des environnements et à l'amélioration des processus d'exploitation Participer à la mise en place de solutions de supervision et de monitoring (Centreon, Zabbix, Prometheus, Grafana...) Virtualisation & infrastructure Administrer les environnements virtualisés (VMware, Nutanix, KVM...) Participer à la gestion des infrastructures de stockage et de sauvegarde Contribuer au déploiement et à l'évolution des infrastructures on-premise et cloud Intervenir sur les problématiques de disponibilité, de performance et de résilience des systèmes Participer aux projets de migration et de modernisation des infrastructures Linux Réseau & sécurité des systèmes Assurer la configuration et le bon fonctionnement des services réseau sous Linux Intervenir sur les problématiques de connectivité et de communication entre systèmes Appliquer les bonnes pratiques de sécurisation et de durcissement des environnements Linux Gérer les droits d'accès, les comptes utilisateurs et les permissions Participer à la gestion des vulnérabilités et à l'application des politiques de sécurité Documentation & amélioration continue Rédiger et maintenir les procédures techniques et les documentations d'exploitation Participer à l'analyse des incidents et à la mise en place d'actions correctives Collaborer avec les équipes infrastructures, réseaux, cybersécurité et DevOps Être force de proposition dans l'optimisation, l'automatisation et la fiabilisation des environnements techniques Votre Environnement De Travail Vous rejoindrez une équipe engagée et bienveillante , où le partage d’expertise et la progression collective occupent une place centrale. Au sein de notre communauté cyber, vous aurez accès à : Des formations certifiantes : certifications éditeurs, sécurité des infrastructures, CISSP, CCNA/CCNP Security, etc. Des workshops techniques, communautés et événements internes pour échanger entre pairs Des opportunités de rayonnement : conférences, interventions en écoles, publications Chez SII, la curiosité est encouragée , le développement des compétences est soutenu et la collaboration au cœur des pratiques. Diplômé·e d'une école d'ingénieur ou d'un cursus universitaire équivalent, vous justifiez d'au moins 3 ans d'expérience en administration de systèmes Linux. Vos Atouts Vous maîtrisez les environnements Linux et les principales commandes d'administration système. Vous possédez de bonnes connaissances en scripting Shell/Bash et en automatisation. Vous êtes à l'aise avec les environnements virtualisés et les fondamentaux réseaux (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, SSH...). Vous avez une sensibilité aux enjeux de sécurité, de supervision et de maintien en condition opérationnelle. Une connaissance des outils DevOps, de la conteneurisation (Docker, Kubernetes) ou des environnements cloud constitue un atout. Au-delà de vos compétences techniques, nous recherchons une personne autonome, rigoureuse, curieuse et appréciant le travail en équipe. Chez SII, la diversité des secteurs, des architectures et des problématiques techniques nourrit votre expertise et accélère votre évolution. Depuis plus de 40 ans , nous accompagnons nos clients dans les secteurs de l’Aéronautique & Défense, la Banque, l’Energie, les Transports et les Télécoms. Grâce à nos référencements clés et à notre positionnement auprès d’acteurs majeurs tels que Thales, Airbus, la SNCF, BNP Paribas, Bouygues Télécom ou Enedis, … nos collaborateurs interviennent sur des projets à forte valeur ajoutée , souvent en environnements critiques, à grande échelle ou fortement sécurisés . Pourquoi rejoindre notre communauté IT for Engineering ? Face aux enjeux croissants de performance, de connectivité, de résilience et de transformation numérique, nos équipes accompagnent les grands industriels et opérateurs dans la conception, le déploiement et l'évolution de leurs infrastructures et systèmes techniques. Forts de plusieurs centaines d'ingénieurs et experts , nous intervenons sur un large spectre d'activités : Ingénierie réseaux et télécoms : infrastructures LAN/WAN, réseaux industriels, communications critiques, connectivité et architectures distribuées Systèmes & infrastructures IT : architectures serveurs, virtualisation, cloud, exploitation et modernisation des environnements techniques Ingénierie Systèmes : intégration, validation, qualification et maintien en condition opérationnelle de systèmes complexes Automatisation & transformation Digitale : industrialisation des processus, Infrastructure as Code, automatisation et modernisation des outils d'exploitation Ingénierie de Production & Support : supervision, performance, disponibilité et amélioration continue des systèmes critiques En rejoignant SII, vous évoluerez sur des projets d'envergure au sein d' équipes plutidisciplinaires , tout en bénéficiant d'un environnement favorisant le développement de vos compétences, l'innovation et le partage d'expertise. Qui sommes-nous ? Le groupe SII est au cœur de l’innovation au service de grands comptes dans des secteurs d’ingénierie variés. En 2026, pour la 9ème année consécutive, SII France a obtenu le label Great Place To Work®. Ce succès est le reflet de notre culture basée sur notre volonté de proposer à tous nos salariés un cadre de travail épanouissant pour le développement de leurs compétences et carrières. Rejoindre SII, c’est s’engager dans une aventure collective : Let’s Tech Together ! Cette promesse représente notre ambition commune : construire un futur technologique ensemble, dans un cadre où l'expérimentation et l'autonomie sont encouragées, où les innovations sont au cœur de nos actions, et où chaque collaborateur trouve épanouissement professionnel et responsabilisation au sein d'un collectif enthousiaste et inclusif. En tant que société à fortes valeurs humaines, nous sommes signataires de la Charte d'engagement LGBT+ avec l'Association l'autre Cercle et sommes une entreprise Handi-accueillante. Let’s Tech Together incarne ce que nous sommes et ce que nous aspirons à être : une entreprise dynamique, innovante et humaine. Alors si ces valeurs vous parlent, rejoignez-nous !
